title: Tool library dialog: U4 holder, stick-out and gauge length

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P4
labels.description: Work the maintainer asked for, for the next cut

body:
Goal: Set a tool's holder, stick-out and gauge length in the tool library window. The tool Properties page becomes a summary.

Parent: #3663. Plan: the implementation plan in the #3663 comment. This is PR U4 of 11. Refs #808 (item 2 only: re-seed the projection).

Files:
- Add `tool_library_dialog/assembly_group.rs`. It holds the holder link (`tool_holder_picker::holder_picker`), gauge length, projection, the read-only total, the `fits_shank` warning, and other tapers marked against the machine's `tooling.spindle_mount`. It also holds a folded "Body" section and the stand-in `holder_d` and `holder_len` (only when there is no body).
- `state_tool_profile.rs` `pick_library_holder`: when `flute_len + shank_len` of the stored tool changes, seed the projection draft again and mark it as changed. The stored `HolderRef` never changes by itself.
- `tool_settings.rs`: the property page becomes a summary with an "Edit in tool library" button.
- `tool_profile_page.rs` `editor`: the holder picker leaves the shape window.

Tests (new): `layout_window_tool_editor` gets the assembly group. `tool_library_assembly::a_tool_length_change_reseeds_the_projection_draft_only`, `apply_holder_is_one_set_tool_body`, `a_shank_the_holder_cannot_take_is_warned`.
Tests moved, not deleted: `layout_page_tool`, `tool_settings_form_a_label_left_grid_in_collapsible_groups`, `tool_holder.rs`, `tool_holder_reference.rs`, `tool_body*.rs`, `layout_window_tool_shape`, `structural::tool_editor_structure`. Count the `#[test]` items of `crates/ui` before and after.

Depends on: U2 (#3893) and U3 (#3894).

Commands: `SetToolBody::library`, existing `SetToolBody` paths, `ChangeTool`. Nothing new. No MCP tool is owed.

Expected quick gate: 10 steps, plus `state_tool_profile.rs` (not measured). Safety floor applies: effort:high, because holder geometry feeds the collision checks.

Done means: a user sets the holder, gauge length and stick-out in the window, and "Apply holder" is one `SetToolBody` undo step. A tool length change re-seeds only the projection draft. A shank that the holder cannot take shows a warning. The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` does not go down.

Changelog row: Set a tool's holder, gauge length and stick-out in the tool library window. The stick-out follows a change of tool length before you apply the holder. The tool's Properties page is now a summary.
